questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence.

A) I have finished my homework since yesterday.
B) I have finished my homework for two hours ago.
C) I have finished my homework since two hours ago.
D) I finished my homework since two hours ago.
options: A) I have finished my homework since yesterday.
B) I have finished my homework for two hours ago.
C) I have finished my homework since two hours ago.
D) I finished my homework since two hours ago.
questions.answer: C) I have finished my homework since two hours ago.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the present perfect tense?

A) She has lived in London for five years.
B) She lives in London for five years.
C) She is living in London for five years.
D) She lived in London for five years.
options: A) She has lived in London for five years.
B) She lives in London for five years.
C) She is living in London for five years.
D) She lived in London for five years.
questions.answer: A) She has lived in London for five years.

questions.question:
Select the correct option to complete the sentence.

If it ______ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.

A) rains
B) will rain
C) is raining
D) rained
options: A) rains
B) will rain
C) is raining
D) rained

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses the second conditional?

A) If I had enough money, I buy a car.
B) If I had enough money, I would buy a car.
C) If I have enough money, I buy a car.
D) If I had enough money, I will buy a car.
options: A) If I had enough money, I buy a car.
B) If I had enough money, I would buy a car.
C) If I have enough money, I buy a car.
D) If I had enough money, I will buy a car.
questions.answer: B) If I had enough money, I would buy a car.

questions.question:
Choose the correct modal verb.

You should ______ more exercise to stay healthy.

A) do
B) doing
C) to do
D) to be doing
options: A) do
B) doing
C) to do
D) to be doing

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the verb.

After he ______ from university, he started his own business.

A) graduated
B) is graduating
C) has graduated
D) would graduate
options: A) graduated
B) is graduating
C) has graduated
D) would graduate

questions.question:
Which sentence is grammatically correct?

A) I am happy to meet you now.
B) I am happy to meet you today.
C) I am happy to meet you tomorrow.
D) I am happy to meet you yesterday.
options: A) I am happy to meet you now.
B) I am happy to meet you today.
C) I am happy to meet you tomorrow.
D) I am happy to meet you yesterday.
questions.answer: B) I am happy to meet you today.

questions.question:
Choose the correct comparative form.

My sister is ______ than my mother.

A) younger
B) more younger
C) the most younger
D) much younger
options: A) younger
B) more younger
C) the most younger
D) much younger

questions.question:
Select the correct infinitive or gerund.

It is difficult ______ patience.

A) to have
B) having
C) to having
D) have
options: A) to have
B) having
C) to having
D) have

questions.question:
Which sentence uses the gerund correctly?

A) I enjoy swimming in the sea.
B) I enjoy to swim in the sea.
C) I enjoy of swimming in the sea.
D) I enjoy by swimming in the sea.
options: A) I enjoy swimming in the sea.
B) I enjoy to swim in the sea.
C) I enjoy of swimming in the sea.
D) I enjoy by swimming in the sea.
questions.answer: A) I enjoy swimming in the sea.
